question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Silent
solution:
The correct answer is **'Noisy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Silent'**, in English, means not making or accompanied by any sound; quiet or still (चुप).

 
 
• **Example: **The library was completely silent as everyone was focused on their books.
 
 
 
• Conversely, the word **'Noisy'**, the correct answer, means making or given to making a lot of noise (शोरीला).
 
 
• **Example: **The classroom became noisy as soon as the teacher left the room.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'Noisy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Utterable' **refers to something that can be spoken or expressed (उच्चारण योग्य).
 
• **'Mum' **is another way to describe silence or the act of not speaking (मौन).
 
• **'Mute' **means silent or refraining from speech (मूक).
